name: hrms-demo
description: HRMS Demo: a sellable, customisable HR management webapp (staff, documents, org tree, payroll, attendance with geofencing, leave, assets, employee journey)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
